titleEn: Describing a problem and its cause
explanationAr: عند وصف مشكلة فنية، اذكر ثلاثة أشياء: ما المشكلة، ومتى بدأت، وما سببها المحتمل. ومن العبارات المفيدة: There is a leak in... و The problem started on... و This is probably caused by... و As a result, ... واستخدم probably أو may عندما لا تكون متأكدًا، ولا تكتب السبب كأنه مؤكد قبل الفحص.
explanationEn: When you describe a technical problem, say three things: what the problem is, when it started, and its probable cause. Useful phrases: There is a leak in... The problem started on... This is probably caused by... As a result, ... Use probably or may when you are not sure. Do not write a cause as a fact before it is checked.

comparison.en: There is a leak in the main pipe.
This is probably caused by high pressure.
comparison.noteAr: caused by، و probably لعدم التأكد.

examples.en: There is a leak in the main pipe near valve 3.
examples.ar: يوجد تسرّب في الأنبوب الرئيسي قرب الصمام رقم 3.

examples.en: The problem started on Monday morning.
This is probably caused by high pressure.
As a result, the pump stopped twice.

exercises.prompt: The crack is probably caused ___ settlement of the soil.

exercises.sentence: The leak caused by an old joint.
accepted: The leak was caused by an old joint.
The leak is caused by an old joint.
exercises.explanationAr: نحتاج was أو is قبل caused: The leak was caused by...

exercises.prompt: There is ___ leak in the main pipe.
exercises.explanationAr: نذكر التسرّب أول مرة، و leak تبدأ بصوت ساكن: a leak.
الفاعل ثم الفعل الماضي ثم الوقت.

exercises.sentence: There is a damage to the wall near the door.
accepted: There is damage to the wall near the door.
There is some damage to the wall near the door.
exercises.explanationAr: damage بمعنى «ضرر» غير معدود، فلا نضع قبله a.

exercises.prompt: The pump stopped ___ the power failed.
exercises.explanationAr: the power failed جملة، فنستخدم because.
